name.description: Extension name. Must not contain the word Google.

description.message: Open each Google service in the account you choose: Gmail in your work account, YouTube in your personal one.

html_lang.description: BCP 47 language tag of this translation, used for <html lang>.

auto_switch.description: Label of the on/off toggle for automatic account switching.

access_text.message: The extension has no access to Google and YouTube pages, so it can't switch accounts.

accounts_empty.message: Add the email addresses of the accounts you're already signed in to in this browser.

no_default.description: Option meaning: leave the account as is for this service.

accounts_click_to_open.message: Click an account to open $SERVICE$ in it

err_email.message: That doesn't look like an email address.

err_duplicate.message: This account is already in the list.

pin_all.message: Open all services in this account

unpin_all.message: Stop using this account by default

exceptions_help.message: Every service opens in the default account. Click a service to pick another.

exceptions_help_no_default.message: Hover an account and click “default account” to use it everywhere, or pick accounts per service.

privacy_link.description: Link in Settings to the privacy policy page.
